pull.title: MINOR: Speed up transaction index lookup with binary search
pull.body: ### Motivation `TransactionIndex.collectAbortedTxns` sequentially reads and deserializes every index record from the beginning of the file. For a `READ_COMMITTED` fetch near the end of a segment with many aborted transactions, this can decode tens of thousands of records whose `lastOffset` is too old to overlap the fetch. ### Changes - Use binary search over the fixed-size records to find the first potentially overlapping record by `lastOffset` and the original termination point by `lastStableOffset`. - Retain a sequential path for fetches that overlap the first record, reusing the decoded first record to avoid regressions for reads at the beginning of the index. - Share the positional record decoder with the existing iterator. The on-disk format, public API, and per-record heap usage are unchanged. Both search keys are non-decreasing for valid Kafka-generated indexes: abort markers are appended in log-offset order, while LSO is the earliest remaining transaction's first offset, or the completed marker's offset plus one. A new out-of-order transaction-completion test covers this ordering precondition. The new tests also compare records, order, and `isComplete` against the sequential implementation over 1,000 generated fetch ranges, including the case where the LSO termination point precedes the first overlapping transaction. ### Tests - `./gradlew :storage:test --tests org.apache.kafka.storage.internals.log.TransactionIndexTest --tests org.apache.kafka.storage.internals.log.ProducerStateManagerTest.testLastStableOffsetDoesNotRegressWhenTransactionsCompleteOutOfOrder --tests 'org.apache.kafka.storage.internals.log.UnifiedLogTest.*TransactionIndex*' --tests 'org.apache.kafka.storage.internals.log.UnifiedLogTest.*ReadCommitted*' --tests 'org.apache.kafka.storage.internals.log.UnifiedLogTest.*Aborted*'` - `./gradlew spotlessApply checkstyleMain checkstyleTest spotlessCheck` ### Benchmark The included JMH benchmark was run unchanged before and after the optimization on Java 25, with 2 forks, 2 warmups, and 3 measurement iterations of 1 second each. All 18 parameter combinations improved, with non-overlapping 99.9% confidence intervals. These are hot-page-cache index-lookup microbenchmarks, not end-to-end fetch measurements.
